The Role  
 Help us build the operating system for human longevity. 
 Virtusan is a Swiss-based longevity ecosystem at the intersection of science, technology, and premium real-world experiences. We connect data, behaviour, and environments so people can live longer, better lives. We're a small team and offer real ownership from day one. 
 We need someone who owns their work completely: defines the experience, conducts the research, designs the flows, and iterates without waiting to be asked. 
 This is not just an execution role. You will shape how our app is used, how it guides people through their health data, and whether it actually changes how they live. You will be accountable for outcomes, not just outputs. The measure of your work is whether users build real habits, understand their biology, and come back because the product earns it. 
 Tasks 
  What You'll Own  
  Product concept and experience design  
 
 Originate new product concepts from scratch, not just improve what exists 
 Design complete user journeys that translate complex biometric data into clear, motivating daily guidance 
 Ensure every flow serves behaviour change, not just usability: ask why a feature exists and what it helps the user to accomplish, not just how it should work 
 Hold the line on experience quality across the full app 
 
  User research  
 
 Plan and run your own user research: interviews, usability tests, diary studies, and in-app feedback loops 
 Turn qualitative and quantitative signals into actionable design decisions 
 Build and maintain a clear picture of who our users are, what motivates them, and where we lose them 
 Bring user evidence into every design conversation 
 
  Design execution  
 
 Build and evolve our next app version with fast protoptyping in Figma or Claude Design moving fast without sacrificing foundamentals 
 Design for the constraints of mobile: clarity, performance, and one-handed use 
 Maintain our design library and high-fidelity mock ups. Ensure consistency across components, patterns, and interaction models 
 Collaborate closely with product and engineering to ship what you design 
 
  Iteration and quality  
 
 Define success metrics for your work and track them 
 Test your assumptions before and after launch 
 Spot what isn't working and fix it, with or without a brief 
 
 Requirements 
 
 6 to 7 years of experience as a product or UX designer, with a portfolio that shows end-to-end ownership 
 Proven ability to originate product concepts, not just refine existing ones 
 Deep mobile app design experience: you understand iOS patterns, constraints, and work with a small screen 
 Strong user research skills: you design the study, run it, synthesise it, and act on it 
 Expert-level Figma skills and a clean, efficient design process. Experience with AI tools to accelerate the whole design process. 
 Fast prototyping and concept validation: you build lightweight, testable prototypes early to prove or disprove an idea before committing to full design. You iterate quickly on evidence and know when something is ready to build and when it isn't 
 Able to design for behaviour change: you understand how habits form and how design can support or undermine them 
 Strong written English: your product design copy is natural and is an integral part of your designed flows 
 Takes ownership: makes well-reasoned calls independently rather than waiting for direction 
 Based geographically in EU/UK timezone. Applications from Asia or the Americas will not be considered. 
 
  The following are strong advantages:  
 
 Experience in health, wellness, or longevity products 
 Experience building data products & data visualisations 
 B2C product experience 
 Fluency in German 
 
  Send a resume with a portfolio link or attachment showing work you have led: original concepts, user research, full journeys, shipped mobile experiences.

About Co-Star 
 Someone downloads Co–Star every 5 seconds.  
 In the five years since we launched, 25% of young people 18-25 in the US have downloaded the app.  Big Sean  has rapped about us, Ariana Grande &  Kevin Durant  post screenshots to their IGs, and we’ve been  App of the Day  twice. We’ve been featured in the New York Times three times, this year on the cover of  NYT Style . We have a global following, in 193 countries – missing just North Korea and Eritrea.  
 We don't pay for marketing – we designed the app to go viral, and it did.  
 Astrology has been popular for 4,000 years. 
 Astrology is a tool for speaking about yourself, about who you are, what you’re experiencing, and how you relate to other people – in other words, a language for the things that really matter. It’s a structured system, based on the physical locations of the planets in the sky, developed over millennia 4,000 years of practice.  
 Everyone has memories of reading a horoscope in the newspaper. You know your sign the same way you know the name of the street you grew up on.  An average of 43% of Americans have believed in astrology since the 1970s.   
 We’re merging the resonance of the humanities with the precision of technology.  
 Co-Star uses real-time NASA data and AI to bring this practice to the modern age. Every day, Co–Star generates millions of hyper-personalized horoscopes – a scale never previously possible. Every word of it is based on each person’s unique astrology: where the stars physically were when they were born and where those same stars are now. Co–Star combines the art of ancient practice with cutting-edge artificial intelligence, creating the first synthetic text to be called “wildly beautiful.” 
 We’re a small, experienced team.  
 Co-Star is a team of 30, with experience in big tech (Amazon, Google, Snapchat), entertainment (Frank Ocean, Adult Swim), and academia (Harvard, Stanford, NYU, Columbia).  
 About the brand designer role 
 We're looking for a talented visual designer to shape how Co-Star shows up outside of the app, in the broader world. We are looking for someone with a fresh, opinionated, and high-quality design foundation who can create work that feels distinct, not what’s now but what’s next.  
 You'll partner closely with the leadership on campaigns and visual storytelling across earned and owned channels. This is a freelance engagement with potential for a long-term partnership as the work (and team) grows. 
 What you'll do 
 
 Design campaign visuals: ads, social, launches — from concept through finished assets 
 Bring editorial design sensibility to our owned channels: email/welcome series, blog, campaign imagery 
 Develop visual systems that are expressive rather than corporate 
 Partner with marketing on what earned and owned should look and feel like 
 Collaborate async with a small, fast-moving team 
 
 You might be a fit if 
 
 You're a senior IC — roughly 5–8 years in — with a portfolio of expressive, culturally fluent graphic design: editorial, campaigns, identities across print and digital 
 Typography and composition are your first language 
 You can direct as well as execute: you've shaped campaigns, not just produced assets for them 
 You're plugged into visual culture across art, fashion, publishing, music, and the internet 
 You work well remotely and independently 
 
 Nice to have 
 
 Editorial/publication experience (print or digital magazines) 
 Motion or illustration 
 You already make things with generative tools 
 
 Logistics 
 
 Freelance/contract, part-time to start, with room to grow 
 Fully remote, anywhere. No travel required (though you're always welcome in NYC)  
 
 To apply 
 Send your portfolio. We care about taste, range, and point of view.

 We are seeking an experienced  Structured Cabling Design Engineer  to support the design and delivery of structured cabling and physical network infrastructure for hyperscale and enterprise data center environments. 
 This remote position will be responsible for developing scalable, standards-compliant fiber and copper cabling designs from concept through construction and deployment. The engineer will work closely with data center design, network engineering, construction, operations, vendors, and deployment teams to ensure cabling infrastructure meets capacity, reliability, maintainability, and future-growth requirements. 
 Key Responsibilities

 Design fiber-optic and copper cabling systems supporting data center network, compute, storage, management, security, and building infrastructure. 
 Develop  MDF, IDF, MMR, network room, meet-me-room, and data hall connectivity designs . 
 Create fiber backbone, horizontal cabling, interconnect, cross-connect, and equipment connectivity architectures. 
 Develop  single-line diagrams, cabling schematics, rack elevations, patching diagrams, pathway layouts, fiber routing plans, and connectivity schedules . 
 Determine fiber counts, cable types, connector types, patch-panel requirements, termination methods, and pathway capacity. 
 Design solutions using  single-mode and multimode fiber , including high-density fiber connectivity and MPO/MTP-based systems where applicable. 
 Specify Category 6/6A copper infrastructure and associated patching systems. 
 Perform cable pathway, tray, conduit, ladder rack, and containment capacity calculations. 
 Coordinate structured cabling requirements with network architecture, electrical, mechanical, architectural, security, and construction disciplines. 
 Review construction drawings, BIM/CAD models, specifications, submittals, RFIs, and vendor proposals. 
 Develop  Bills of Materials (BOMs)  and support material forecasting and procurement. 
 Create and maintain cabling standards, design guidelines, naming conventions, labeling requirements, and installation specifications. 
 Ensure designs comply with applicable  TIA, BICSI, IEEE, NEC/NFPA, ISO/IEC, and manufacturer standards . 
 Support data center capacity planning and determine future fiber, copper, rack, and pathway requirements. 
 Review contractor installation packages and ensure field implementation aligns with approved designs. 
 Support fiber testing, copper certification, commissioning, punch-list resolution, and project closeout. 
 Review OTDR, insertion-loss, and certification test results where applicable. 
 Participate remotely in design reviews, construction coordination meetings, and technical troubleshooting. 
 Conduct occasional site surveys and field inspections when required. 
 Identify design risks, constructability issues, capacity constraints, and opportunities for standardization. 
 Maintain accurate  as-built documentation, cable schedules, port assignments, rack elevations, and connectivity records . 
 Work across multiple concurrent data center projects while maintaining design quality and schedule commitments.

fb8b91b5cbc25822.jd:
Who we are  
 Moniepoint is Africa's all-in-one financial ecosystem, empowering businesses and their customers with seamless payment, banking, credit, and management tools. In 2023, we processed $182 billion and are Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer. 
  Job Purpose  
 Sits between Finance and the Product & Technology platform team, as products are built, ensuring every new product, feature, or pricing change is correctly designed from an accounting and control standpoint before it ships. Owns the thread from customer journey to financial reporting: how a product event is captured, how it maps to the chart of accounts, and how it lands in the Group's financial statements. 
  Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work?  Check out posts on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth.   
  Responsibilities:  
 
 Act as the standing technical accounting partner to Product and Engineering for all new products, features, and pricing changes 
 Write technical accounting memos and position papers for new or changed products (revenue recognition under IFRS 15, financial instrument classification under IFRS 9, fee vs. interest income treatment, etc.) 
 Design, build, and maintain the chart of accounts for new and existing products, ensuring consistency across entities 
 Map each stage of the customer journey (onboarding, transaction, settlement, fee, reversal, write-off) to the correct GL treatment, end to end 
 Review product and engineering specs pre-launch to flag accounting and control gaps before they reach production 
 Own the reconciliation between product/transaction system data and the general ledger, and resolve breaks at source 
 Design controls around new product flows (maker-checker, reconciliation, exception handling) and document them to audit standard 
 Maintain a living library of accounting treatment documentation per product, kept current as products evolve 
 Partner with Financial Control, Internal Audit, and external auditors on product-related technical accounting queries 
 
  Candidate requirements:  
 
 ACA / ACCA (or equivalent) with 8+ years post-qualification experience, including Big 4 technical accounting or audit background 
 Strong working knowledge of IFRS 15 (revenue), IFRS 9 (financial instruments), and IFRS more broadly 
 Experience translating a product or system design into accounting treatment and GL structure, not just reviewing after the fact 
 Comfortable reading product specs and talking directly to engineers and product managers, not only to finance colleagues 
 
  Preffered Qualifications  
 
 Experience in payments, fintech, or banking, ideally with exposure to how transaction/ledger systems are built 
 Prior experience designing or restructuring a chart of accounts for a multi-product platform 
 Exposure to regulatory reporting requirements tied to product design (CBN, FCA, CBK or equivalent) 
 Experience working inside or alongside an agile product/engineering team 
 
   About You:  
 
 You can sit in a product spec review and immediately see where the accounting will break, and say so before launch, not after 
 You translate fluently between accountants and engineers without dumbing either side down 
 You default to documenting the treatment properly rather than leaving it as tribal knowledge 
 You're comfortable owning a chart of accounts as a living system, not a static reference document 
 You care as much about the control design as the accounting answer. A technically correct treatment with no control around it isn't good enough 
 
  What success looks like:  
 
 No product ships without a documented, signed-off accounting treatment and GL mapping 
 Chart of accounts stays clean and consistent as new products launch, with no post-hoc reclassification projects 
 Product/transaction data reconciles to the GL within agreed tolerances, with breaks resolved at source, not papered over monthly 
 Audit findings related to product accounting or control design trend toward zero 
 Product and Engineering see Finance as a design partner, not a late-stage blocker 
 
  What to expect in the hiring process  
 
 A preliminary phone call with one of our recruiters. 
 Hiring Manager Interview  
 A Panel interview with existing Finance Leads 
 A behavioural and technical interview with a member of the Executive team.

16e4f8cb6a77a811.title: Product Auditor
16e4f8cb6a77a811.jd:
Who We Are  
  
 Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.  
 As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually. 
  What We Do  
 At Moniepoint, we are a customer-focused community dedicated to crafting solutions that redefine our industry. We leverage artificial intelligence and data-driven best practices to support our businesses, from providing credit and overdrafts to ensuring every transaction is secure. 
   Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out our stories on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth.   
  Role Overview  
 The Product Auditor provides independent assurance over the design, implementation, and operating effectiveness of product controls across payment, wallet, settlement, switches and other related products across the organisation 
 The role ensures that new and existing products are deployed with adequate financial, operational, security, and regulatory controls, safeguarding the organization against revenue leakage, settlement failures, regulatory breaches, and technology-driven risks. 
 The Product Auditor will independently evaluate product risk exposure and control maturity prior to scale. 
  Key Responsibilities   
  Audit Universe & Risk-Based Planning  
 
 Maintain a living Product Audit Universe covering all payment products, features, and integrations ranked by risk.    
 Own the annual Product Audit Plan, ensuring coverage is allocated dynamically based on risk ratings, product complexity, regulatory sensitivity, and change velocity. 
 
  Product Design & Control Assurance  
 
 Review PRDs, business rules, and transaction workflows to identify logic gaps, unmitigated risk paths, and missing exception-handling routines before products reach production/go-live.    
 Analyse product path scenarios, verify Maker-Checker enforcement, and provide formal control design sign-off before any material release goes live. 
 
  Live Product Assessment ( Continuous Audit Review)  
 
 Periodically assess live payment products to confirm they continue to operate within approved design parameters.    
 Detect configuration drift, identify silent divergence from original PRDs, and analyse live transaction data for emerging risk patterns. 
 
  Go-Live Readiness & Control Gate  
 
 Execute mandatory pre-production Product Audit reviews as an independent control gate for all material releases.    
 Confirm reconciliation logic, exception queues, and fallback controls are tested and functional.    
 Escalate critical deficiencies with risk ratings and hold recommendations where a product is not safe to release. 
 
  Transaction Logic & Mathematical Integrity  
 
 Interrogate the Fee Engine using SQL to mathematically prove that commissions, VAT, discounts, and splits are posted with complete precision.    
 Validate duplicate prevention mechanisms and ensure transaction integrity within complex, multi-step payment sequences, and test reversal, refund, and chargeback logic to confirm financial symmetry is maintained in every scenario. 
 
  Settlement & Ledger Integrity  
 
 Trace fund flows, confirming continuous synchronisation between wallet sub-ledgers and the General Ledger.    
 Assess reconciliation logic for breaks and evaluate the authorisation, documentation, and reversibility of manual settlement overrides. 
 
  Product Change & Configuration Integrity  
 
 Confirm that all product modifications: fee tables, routing rules, limit parameters passed through an approved change management cycle.    
 Identify silent changes made outside formal release processes and audit the integrity of product master data to ensure it is access-controlled, version-tracked, and consistent with approved product terms. 
 
  Vendor & Third-Party Product Risk  
 
 Assess controls over vendor-managed product components, evaluate SLA performance against contractual commitments, and identify single-vendor dependency risks within critical payment flows.    
 Evaluate the organisation's ability to detect unilateral changes in third-party API behaviour, fee logic, or settlement processes. 
 
  Control Advisory & Stakeholder Engagement  
 
 Engage product and engineering teams early in the design cycle to provide informal control advisory, reducing findings at the formal review stage without compromising independence.    
 Participate in design reviews and architecture discussions, and build a control-by-design culture across product teams.  
 
  Incident Review, RCA & Regulatory Alignment  
 
 Lead post-incident reviews for product failures,producing structured RCA reports that identify underlying logic failures, not just surface symptoms.    
 Assess corrective actions for adequacy and track findings to verify closure.    
 Ensure product logic complies with CBN guidelines, PCI DSS, and consumer protection obligations at the design level, and evaluate the regulatory impact of new features before release. 
 
  Reporting & Governance  
 
 Prepare risk-rated audit reports for Executive Management and the Audit Committee, leading with findings, financial impact, and required action.    
 Maintain a Product Risk Register, deliver quarterly control maturity updates, and ensure governance bodies are never surprised by a product failure that was visible at the design or portfolio review stage. 
 
  Required Knowledge & Skills   
  Technical Skills  
 
 Advanced SQL for independent data extraction and transaction interrogation 
 Payment systems architecture : Wallets, card processing, direct debit, settlement, and reconciliation 
 API and integration literacy (Basic) 
 End-to-end transaction lifecycle knowledge: Authorisation, posting, clearing, settlement, and exception handling 
 PRD and process flow analysis: translating product documentation into control flowcharts 
 Mathematical precision: fee calculations, interest computations, and split payment structures 
 Pattern recognition: detecting anomalies, outliers, and irregularities in large transaction datasets 
 
  Audit & Risk Skills  
 
 Risk-based audit methodology: IIA Standards and COSO framework applied to financial products. 
 Control design logic and evaluation 
 Root cause analysis 
 Regulatory knowledge: CBN payment system regulations, PCI DSS, NDPR,Nigerian consumer protection obligations etc 
 
  Interpersonal & Professional Skills  
 
 Stakeholder engagement 
 Professional scepticism and independence 
 Risk-rated report writing 
 
  Tools & Platforms  
 
 SQL (PostgreSQL / MySQL / MSSQL) 
 AdvancedExcel / Google Sheets 
 Claude / AI Tools 
 
  Qualifications  
 
  Education:  Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Finance, or a related quantitative discipline 
  Experience:  3–5+ years in Product Audit, Systems Audit, Financial Data Analytics, or Payment Operations within a fintech or financial services environment 
  Certifications:  CISA, CIA, or CFE preferred. ACA / ACCA is acceptable when combined with strong technical product experience and data analytics. 
  Sector Knowledge:  Demonstrated hands-on familiarity with payment product architecture, wallet systems, and regulated payment flows in a Nigerian or comparable market context. 
 
  What We Offer You  
 
  Culture:  We put our people first and prioritize the well-being of every team member. We’re human, we listen, and we look out for one another. 
  Learning:  We’re big on growth. You’ll find an environment focused on knowledge sharing, training, and helping you reach your potential. 
  Compensation:  You’ll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, and an annual bonus, along with other great benefits. 
 
  What to Expect in the Hiring Process  
 
 A preliminary phone call with our recruiter. 
 An interview with the hiring team. 
 A final conversation with a member of our executive team. 
 
  Moniepoint Inc. is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

  Our vision:   A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together.  
      About the Role:  
 Wrike is opening a new talent track for builders- senior engineers who take a feature from a rough idea to a production system on their own, and who use AI as a genuine multiplier rather than a buzzword. This isn’t a backfill for an existing seat. It’s a newly created role for someone who already operates autonomously and wants to keep doing that inside a company with real scale, real users, and daily production deployments. You take a high-level idea, figure out what actually needs to be built by talking to the right people, and ship it end-to-end: backend logic, frontend touches where needed, automated and manual testing, infra, and the dozen adjacent things a real feature needs. You read the existing codebase with judgment- reusing what’s solid, rebuilding what isn’t, and refusing to leave tech debt for the next person. 
 AI is not optional here. You’re expected to work AI-native: using it daily to move faster, and knowing when to push back when it suggests something that doesn’t hold up.  Take ambiguous, high-level product ideas and turn them into a concrete technical plan- by asking the right people the right questions, not waiting for a fully written spec

Work from anywhere, impact everywhere  
 Diversity is at the heart of who we are at Xapo Bank.  We’re a fully distributed team of over 160 Xapiens that work remotely from 50+ countries around the world. 
 Our beginning: A world that enjoys economic freedom and wealth protection,no matter where you live or who is running your country. To achieve that, we search the world for the best people for the job.  We work hard, think globally, and inspire each other to learn and grow.  We are committed to changing the way things are done. 
  Although we are headquartered in Gibraltar, this is a full time, 100% remote position    Work from anywhere!    Position overview 
 As the Head of Design, you will lead our design organisation, owning the design quality of every customer journey end-to-end — how our client-facing touchpoints across product, web and more look, feel, and function at every step — in close partnership with Product, who own the journeys and priorities, and Marketing, who lead brand strategy and identity. 
 This is a broad executive mandate where you will own not only the craft of design but its measurable impact on the business. You will champion design excellence, build deep partnerships with Product and Marketing to ensure a single, cohesive experience from first impression to daily use, and grow a world-class remote design culture. Your mission is to translate complex financial and cryptocurrency concepts into a beautiful, cohesive, and trust-building experience — and to demonstrate, through outcomes, that great design is working. 
   
 Responsibilities 
 
  Design Strategy and Vision.  Define, champion, and execute the long-term design vision for Xapo's client-facing touchpoints across mobile and web — treating measurable user-experience quality, not just aesthetics, as the standard of success.   
  Design Performance & Outcomes.  Own the metrics that demonstrate design's business impact such as task-completion and speed in core journeys and design-system adoption, reporting on these quarterly at the executive level.

  Brand Partnership and Experience Continuity.  Partner closely with Marketing, who lead Xapo's brand strategy and identity, to ensure that brand is expressed faithfully throughout the user journey — creating a seamless aesthetic and narrative transition from public campaigns to in-app transactional flows, with clear swimlanes and shared rituals between the two teams.   
  UX Architecture and Flow Optimisation.  Oversee user research and journey mapping to elevate the design and usability of complex regulatory, private banking, and crypto-native payment flows — working with Product, who own the journeys themselves, to reduce friction without compromising security.   
  Design Systems and Operations.  Scale and govern a unified design language and Figma system — co-developed with Marketing's brand team where the system touches brand expression — to drive velocity, consistency, and visual quality across product and web.   
  Operationalised Research and Testing.  Standardise a culture of data-informed design, embedding regular usability testing and customer discovery as a standard gate before handoff to ensure high-quality, validated releases.   
  Cross-Functional Executive Collaboration.  Work closely with Product and Engineering leadership so the design organisation is engaged early, bringing craft and usability expertise into strategic direction and product requirements from the earliest stages — and act as design's ambassador to Marketing, Compliance, and other key stakeholders.   
  Responsible AI Design Governance.  Partner with security and AI engineering teams to establish a safe, governed framework for utilising AI tools in asset creation and UX personalisation.   
  Team Leadership and Culture.  Recruit, mentor, and lead a remote, multi-disciplinary design organisation spanning Product Design, Research, and UX Writing, fostering a culture of craft, critique, and continuous growth. 
 
   
 Skills needed 
 
 10+ years of digital design experience, with at least 4+ years in an executive leadership role (Director/VP) managing multi-disciplinary design teams in a high-growth fintech, neobank, or digital asset platform.   
 Broad creative fluency, with a strong portfolio demonstrating complex interactive product design executed to a high aesthetic standard, and a proven ability to work within and extend an established brand identity.   
 Proven track record of improving key business and design metrics (conversion, NPS, task completion, and platform ratings) through design-led initiatives.   
 Demonstrated ability to resolve operational friction, streamline design workflows, and build high-trust partnerships with marketing, product, and engineering teams — particularly experience navigating shared ownership of brand between design and marketing functions.   
 Deep knowledge of native mobile platform guidelines (iOS and Android) and modern Web standards, along with experience scaling enterprise-grade design systems.   
 Strong familiarity with the unique UX and trust challenges in fintech, banking, and digital assets.   
 Exceptional communication and executive storytelling skills, with the ability to clearly articulate the business value of design decisions to the C-suite and board.   
 Operational, direct, and collaborative leadership style tailored for a fully remote, globally distributed environment. 
 
   
  Other requirements  
   
 
 A dedicated workspace. 
 A reliable internet connection with the fastest speed possible in your area. 
 Alignment with Our Values and the Xapo Values-Driven Leadership principles. 
   Why work for Xapo? 
 Impact Globally, Work Remotely. 
 
 
  Shape the Future   Improve lives through cutting-edge technology, work 100% remotely from anywhere in the world.   
 
 
  Great work-life balance   Build amazing things with a balance of autonomy and collaborative teamwork. Set your own work schedule and make use of a flexible PTO plan when you need to recharge.      
 
 
  Expect Excellence   Collaborate, learn, and grow with a high-performance team. Learn   how you learn best - from books to conferences, you’ll get a yearly budget for your individual learning and development goals.

 About the Role 
 At Finom, product decisions are made fast — and we want them made well. As our  Senior Product Analyst for Growth & Activation , you'll be the analytical engine behind the squads shaping how new customers discover, adopt, and grow with our product. 
 You'll sit embedded inside the Growth & Activation product stream, working shoulder-to-shoulder with Product Managers and cross-functional squads, while reporting functionally to the Head of Product Analytics to keep our metrics rigorous and consistent. Your job is to turn data into insight, hypotheses into experiments, and outcomes into learnings that genuinely move the roadmap. 
 This is a builder's role. The data foundations are there, but the metric system around them is yours to design and document. If you've ever wanted a blank canvas to build an analytical setup the way it  should  be built — without layers of bureaucracy slowing you down — this is that opportunity. 
 What You Will Be Doing 
 
  Be the analytical lead  embedded across the four product teams in the Growth & Activation stream, partnering closely with PMs to make their decisions faster, smarter, and measurable. 
  Translate product hypotheses and business problems  into clear, measurable analytical questions and scalable models. 
  Design, instrument, and evaluate experiments and A/B tests  alongside PMs and Engineers, so every product change can be assessed in real business terms — activation, retention, engagement, or revenue. 
  Monitor product performance, funnel dynamics, and behavioral cohorts  to surface early signals of impact, degradation, or new opportunity — and proactively challenge assumptions through opportunity sizing and trade-off analysis. 
  Build decisioning frameworks  — from scoring systems and rules to predictive or optimization models — that directly shape product logic and strategy, prototyping in SQL, Python, or notebooks before partnering with Data Science to productionize. 
  Define and maintain success metrics and driver trees  for your product area, aligned with our company-wide metric architecture, and automate dashboards for ongoing KPI and experiment visibility. 
  Apply statistical and causal methods  (e.g., Bayesian estimation, difference-in-differences, synthetic control, uplift modeling) when clean randomization isn't possible. 
  Collaborate across functions  — Data Science, Growth, Marketing Analytics, Finance, and Engineering — on shared models and KPIs such as LTV, CAC payback, and pricing elasticity, and contribute to company-wide frameworks for activation, retention, and monetization.

dc75d1ae9b458bf3.jd:
JTX is our trading app, and it runs on the fastest market infrastructure on Solana, which we also built. It’s live today, self-custodial, and native mobile apps are in development.  
  We’re looking for a Product Designer to focus mainly on JTX, but you’ll also have the chance to help with other Jito products as needed.  
  We’re a small team and have already found product-market fit. This shapes the way we work:  
 
 
  You’ll make real decisions, not just work through a backlog set by others.  
 
 
  We release features and learn from real user feedback, rather than getting stuck in endless debates.  
 
 
  Attention to detail is essential here. For a trading product, the small things make all the difference.  
 
 
  About the Position  
  You’ll work on UX and UI for both web and native mobile. Right now, our main challenge is making JTX feel clear and trustworthy at a glance, not just functional. You’ll also help keep things consistent between web and mobile, and pitch in on marketing design when needed.  
  You’ll work closely with engineering and product to make the most important decisions. If you’ve ever thought about how traders read a screen under pressure and want to create the product layer that makes speed tangible, this could be the right fit for you.  
  What You’ll Do  
 
 
  Design for JTX across web and mobile, including order entry, market data, charts, positions, execution visibility, onboarding, and wallet flows.  
 
 
  Take features from defining the problem through UX and final UI.  
 
 
  Own and improve the design system and token library that our engineers use.  
 
 
  Help with marketing design when needed, like landing pages, social assets, and launch materials.  
 
 
  Jump in on design work for other Jito products when the team needs extra help.  
 
 
  Release, observe real usage, and keep improving.  
 
 
  Requirements  
 
 
  Strong product sense: you can explain why a decision is right, not just that it looks good.  
 
 
  You can spot issues with hierarchy and clarity on a busy screen and explain what’s causing them.  
 
 
  You’re comfortable working across research, UX, and UI, just like any early-stage product designer needs to.  
 
 
  You can work independently and bring the team in on important decisions, but not every single one.  
 
 
  You’re a true collaborator who communicates proactively and works well with engineering and product.  
 
 
  You’re comfortable giving direct feedback on others’ work and receiving it on your own. Here, critique is quick and specific, never personal.  
 
 
  You’re fluent in Figma and comfortable working directly with token-based design systems.  
 
 
  Preferred (not required)  
 
 
  Experience designing consumer (B2C) crypto or fintech products, or hands-on experience as a trader.  
 
 
  Trading terminals, exchange or brokerage products.  
 
 
  Consumer fintech apps at scale.  
 
 
  Data-dense or real-time interfaces, such as dashboards, analytics, or live data visualization.  
 
 
  Self-custodial wallets, Solana or EVM products.  
 
 
  Experience building or maintaining a token-based design system.

544f834655411c27.jd:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE 

Productions is the 'done for you' managed services wing of ElevenLabs made for creators and media businesses. We bring together our AI audio tools and human experts to unlock human-edited dubs, audiobooks, and more in 15+ languages directly on the ElevenLabs platform.




HERE ARE A FEW RECENT PROJECTS PRODUCTIONS HAS HELPED BRING TO LIFE:

 - Dubbing for some of the world's biggest creators (DudePerfect, Lex Fridman, Andrew Huberman), media businesses (Headspace) and broadcasters (Mediaset)

 - Audiobook production for leading publishers and digital storytelling platforms

 - Voice creation, sound design, and other audio engineering services for ElevenLabs' largest customers

 - You can learn more about Productions here: https://elevenlabs.io/productions




AS A PRODUCTION MANAGER, YOU DRIVE THE SUCCESS OF PRODUCTIONS FOR ONE OR MULTIPLE LANGUAGE TEAMS, INCLUDING:

 - Onboarding and training linguists and other audio professionals (Producers) to use the ElevenLabs platform

 - Building quality control and monitoring systems for your language to ensure the dubs, audiobooks, and other content we deliver sound natural and professional-grade 

 - Working with the Productions product and engineering team to optimize our tools and processes for high-quality content creation

 - Define our editorial line and set our creative direction, such as style guides, voice casting, translation and adaptation principles




REQUIREMENTS

While we don’t require any formal experience, certifications, or degrees, the following will set you apart as a candidate for a Production Manager role:

 - Native speaker of or native-level knowledge of French or Arabic.

 - Experience building and/or running a production team inside a language service provider (LSP), localization agency, media company, or similar for one or multiple of the following:
   
   - Transcripts
   
   - Translations
   
   - Dubs
   
   - Audiobooks

 - Strong attention to detail: you should have keen eyes and ears in your native language and be capable of spotting even the smallest inconsistencies or mistakes that keep something from reading or sounding 100% natural.

 - Comfortable giving feedback: you will be responsible for the quality of content the team produces in your language and should feel comfortable setting and maintaining a high bar.

 - Bonus points for:
   
   - Familiarity with the ElevenLabs platform, including our transcript editor, Studio, and dubbing products
   
   - Native-level abilities in multiple non-English languages




LOCATION

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw.




#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

e078201204b4e2e0.jd:
WunderGraph is a fast-growing startup, our goal is to bring everybody together to build digital products end-to-end. From interface design to API implementation, we provide the platform to go from sketch to product in a category-defining collaborative experience.  Our North Star is to take the friction out of bringing digital ideas to life, making room for your ideas and productivity.

Developers from some of the biggest companies in the world are using WunderGraph to design and streamline their API environments. We raised our Series A ($7.5 million USD) in March 2025, being backed by eBay,  Karma Ventures, and Aspenwood Ventures.

The culture we are creating together is extremely important to us. Read here how we are Building the Company We Always Wanted to Work In https://wundergraph.com/blog/category/culture.

We invite everyone that wants to join us to understand our Core Beliefs  https://www.notion.so/wundergraph/Mission-and-Core-Beliefs-20fb19e0a0ec80c09646fa9101368bceand  if you want to make an impact, have your voice heard, and work in a no-BS organization where you can get stuff done, look no further and apply today so we can chat.



ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Senior Product Designer at WunderGraph, you are the connection between what our users will find most helpful and what our engineers build. Considering the users also happen to be other developers, this becomes an interesting challenge to think about the Developer Experience as the User Experience. You combine sharp user insight, craft, and pragmatism to deliver experiences that are elegant, usable, and built to scale.

This is a wide-reaching role, as design roles at a startup should be. One week you might be running user interviews to shape a new feature; the next, refining our design system or designing a marketing landing page. You ground your work in evidence rather than assumption, partner closely with product and engineering, and turn what you learn about users into a clear, informed UX strategy that guides where we go next.




TEAM INTEGRATION

 - Reports to the VP of Product; is part of the Product team

 - Aligns closely with the CEO (Product) and Head of Customer Success (customer experience and business impact)

 - Collaborate within the Product team with the Delivery Lead and the Design Engineer

 - Collaborates cross-functionally with engineering, marketing, product, and customer success




ROLE OBJECTIVES

You are successful if you:

 - Take ownership of the complete design lifecycle, bridging the gap between initial discovery and final delivery for web and product interfaces.

 - Cultivate an evidence-based UX strategy that leverages user research and data to steer the product's evolution.

 - Oversee the growth of a unified and extensible design system that spans both our product and marketing efforts.

 - Convert user insights and organizational objectives into pragmatic, human-centric solutions engineered for long-term scalability.

 - Advocate for excellence in accessibility, responsiveness, and performance as fundamental pillars of your craft.

 - Provide mentorship to the team, sharing expertise in research methodologies and design principles.

 - Refine the visual and functional identity of WunderGraph through meticulous and high-impact design work.

 - Impact high-level product strategy by demonstrating how user-focused decisions drive tangible business impact.



ROLE TASKS

The role focuses on, but is not limited to:


PRODUCT DESIGN

 - Design and prototype user flows, interfaces, and interactions with scalability in mind.

 - Own design problems end to end. From initial concept through execution and iteration after launch.

 - Rapidly produce wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs, exploring multiple concepts and iterating quickly.

 - Define and evolve our design system and component library, keeping it consistent and maintainable.

 - Partner closely with engineers on feasibility, quality, and handoff, contributing to technical decisions (and coding where you're comfortable and it helps as a plus, not a requirement).

 - Introduce advanced prototyping, interaction design, and motion practices.


UX RESEARCH & STRATEGY

 - Plan and conduct user research across discovery and validation via user interviews, surveys, usability testing, and competitor analysis.

 - Turn ambiguous product questions into decision-grade research that maps to real product and design decisions.

 - Synthesize findings into clear insights, personas, journey maps, and opportunity areas that the team can act on.

 - Build and maintain a shared insight repository so learning is reusable, searchable, and available to everyone.

 - Translate research into an informed, evolving UX strategy that guides the roadmap and anchors design direction in real user needs.

 - Advocate for the user in prioritization and roadmap discussions, and define what "better" looks like through clear UX success metrics.

 - Run discovery workshops and share insights so research shows up where decisions are made like in  design reviews, product planning, and standups embedding user knowledge from the get-go.


WEB & BRAND EXPERIENCE

 - Own the design and evolution of WunderGraph's web presence.

 - Deliver assets that span product and marketing: landing pages, visuals, campaign graphics, and interactive components.

 - Shape and maintain a cohesive style guide, balancing design innovation with consistency.

 - Support brand storytelling with motion graphics and interactive elements.




ROLE REQUIREMENTS



 - Senior-level experience in Product Design or UX/UI Design, with a strong portfolio of shipped work.

 - Proven experience planning and running UX research (both generative and evaluative) and turning findings into strategy.

 - Proficiency in Figma, prototyping tools, and Adobe Creative Suite.

 - Strong background in UX and interaction design, accessibility, responsive design, and usability.

 - Experience contributing to or leading design systems and component libraries.

 - Comfortable using data and research to inform and defend design decisions.

 - Working knowledge of front-end technologies (HTML/CSS, JavaScript a plus) enough to collaborate closely with engineers.

 - Excellent communication, storytelling, and collaboration skills in English.

 - A self-starter who is comfortable with ambiguity and can lead initiatives independently in a fast-moving startup.

 - Comfortable working 100% remotely in a distributed team.

 - Willingness to travel occasionally for team retreats and workshops.








Why WunderGraph?

 - Work from wherever you thrive—we’re fully remote and globally distributed. If you're in Miami, come work with us in person! We also provide co-working space options worldwide if needed.

 - Pick your preferred work hardware

 - We focus on getting stuff done, and on having fun whilst doing so: work hard, play hard!

 - You can make a real difference and find lots of opportunities to grow together with us

 - Discretionary PTO: take the time you need to recharge

 - Competitive compensation

 - Depending on location, we offer healthcare benefits according to local standards

 - Team retreats across the globe

Note: This is a full-time, fully remote position, but we're prioritising candidates from EMEA. We are looking for someone who is available to work during European (CET) business hours.

The Process

We respect your time and interest in WunderGraph. This is why we're aiming to make the process as fast as possible. Here's what you can expect:

 - 30 min intro call with Mariya from our People team

 - 45 min discussion with the hiring manager. Following this, you might receive a small take home assignment related to the role. This is your chance to prove your skill!

 - Complete the assignment and review together with hiring manager

 - Meet the founders

 - Culture fit call with team members

 - Offer

Our process also includes reference and background checks. We aim to respond or provide feedback in 2 or 3 days between each stage of the process. We're usually hiring through Deel as our Employer of Record, except for Germany or Florida where we're hiring directly.

WunderGraph is an equal opportunity workplace; we welcome people from all backgrounds.

You can find out more about our ways of working together here:

WunderGraph Public Handbook and Resources https://www.notion.so/wundergraph/WunderGraph-Public-Handbook-and-Resources-20db19e0a0ec800690cac27c35fadc73

We’re looking forward to your application so we can grow together!

What do we do?

Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payments infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payments fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better.

We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 5000 software sellers in 245 territories globally.



The Role

We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to lead design for Paddle's Core Experience team, the horizontal team responsible for the foundations every other product is built on: sign-up, onboarding, the design system, and the overall Seller Experience. The Core Experience team owns the connective, cross-cutting experience that ties Paddle's products together.

This is a different kind of design role. Rather than owning a single product surface, you'll own the connective tissue that makes Paddle feel like one coherent product. When a seller signs up, gets onboarded, moves between products, or encounters an AI-powered or integrated experience, your work is what makes it feel effortless.

You'll be an active contributor to Paddle's integration and AI experiences, helping shape how Paddle connects to the wider tooling ecosystem and where AI genuinely improves the seller experience. This role asks for exceptional UI craft, deep design systems expertise, and a genuine curiosity about how AI can change both the products we build and the way we design them.

As a holistic problem solver, you'll operate well beyond pixels, balancing hands-on execution with systems thinking, influence, and a high bar for quality. Embedded in a cross-functional team alongside Product and Engineering, you'll work in an environment that values ownership, autonomy, and accountability.



What you'll do:

 - Own the end-to-end design of Paddle's foundational seller experiences, sign-up, onboarding, and the surfaces that connect our products together, from discovery and concepting through delivery, iteration, and long-term evolution.

 - Act as a horizontal partner to all other product teams, creating the guidelines, principles, and reusable patterns that keep the experience consistent across the platform as Paddle grows.

 - Contribute actively to integration and AI experiences, shaping interaction patterns and surfaces, and forming a clear point of view on where AI delivers real user value (and where it gets in the way).

 - Lead design thinking for foundational work, including information architecture, interaction patterns, accessibility, and scalable component design.

 - Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Stakeholders to define problems, shape solutions, influence roadmaps, and ship high-quality outcomes.

 - Use research, data, and customer feedback to validate decisions and continuously improve the experience.

 - Set and uphold quality and craft standards across the product organisation, advocating for user-centred design and a high design bar.

 - Use storytelling to build alignment and secure buy-in for foundational, cross-cutting work that often spans many teams.

 - Mentor and support other designers through collaboration, feedback, and critique.

 - Own and improve the customer experience across a complex B2B platform used by thousands of SaaS companies and millions of their customers.

We'd love to hear from you if you:

 - Bring a strong portfolio with exceptional UI craft, showcasing end-to-end product design with clear problem-solving, interaction design, and visual clarity in complex domains.

 - Have proven experience owning, building, and maintaining design systems, leading their direction, designing components, writing documentation, establishing governance, and driving adoption across teams.

 - Are curious about adopting AI in the design process and in the products you build, and can critically assess where AI delivers real user value and translate it into thoughtful, usable experiences.

 - Are comfortable working horizontally across many teams, aligning stakeholders, balancing competing needs, and creating consistency without slowing teams down.

 - Communicate design decisions clearly and confidently, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.

 - Are a self-starter comfortable with ambiguity, able to own work from discovery through delivery with minimal oversight.

 - Have a solid understanding of implementation constraints, responsive design, and accessibility, and collaborate effectively with engineers on delivery.

 - Possess strong UI design and prototyping skills using Figma, Claude Code (or similar tools).

 - Have experience designing high-scale, consumer-facing or B2B products, experience in SaaS or fintech, with onboarding journeys, or in foundational/platform design is a plus.

 
Everyone is welcome at Paddle

At Paddle, we’re committed to removing invisible barriers, both for our customers and within our own teams. We recognise and celebrate that every Paddler is unique and we welcome every individual perspective. As an inclusive employer we don’t care if, or where, you studied, what you look like or where you’re from. We’re more interested in your craft, curiosity, passion for learning and what you’ll add to our culture. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t match every part of the job ad, especially if you’re part of an underrepresented group.

 Please let us know if there’s anything we can do to better support you through the application process and in the workplace. We will do everything we can to support any accommodations needed. We’re committed to building a diverse team where everyone feels safe to be their authentic self. Let’s grow together.


Why you’ll love working at Paddle

We are a diverse, growing group of Paddlers across the globe who pride ourselves on our transparent, collaborative and respectful culture.

We live and breathe our values, which are:

Paddle for others

Paddle together

Paddle simply

We offer a full suite of benefits, including attractive salaries, stock options, retirement plans, private healthcare and wellbeing initiatives.

We are a ‘digital-first’ company, which means you can work remotely, from one of our stylish  hubs, or even a bit of both! We offer all team members unlimited holidays and 4 months paid family leave regardless of gender. We invest in learning and will help you with your personal development via constant exposure to new challenges, an annual learning fund, and regular internal and external training.

Mission
To advance the adoption of the Walrus Protocol – a Verifiable Data Platform for AI Builders

Vision
To create a foundation for AI builders to store and manage their data, making that data persistent, portable, and under their control across apps, providers, and agents.

Walrus Foundation is looking for a Staff Product Designer to define and own the product experience for Walrus.



Walrus is infrastructure for developers, and designing infrastructure products requires a particular kind of product thinking. Users need to navigate technical concepts, understand system state, work with large amounts of information, configure resources, diagnose problems, and take actions that can have real consequences for their data, storage, or spend.



You'll partner closely with product and engineering from the earliest stages of discovery through implementation. You won't receive finished requirements and turn them into screens. You'll help determine which problems matter, investigate how developers actually work, challenge assumptions, prototype and test potential solutions, and ultimately define how developers experience Walrus.



As a Staff designer, you'll also establish the systems and standards that allow the product to scale. You'll think beyond individual features to create consistent interaction patterns, reusable components, and product principles that make the entire Walrus experience more coherent over time.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the Walrus product experience. Define and evolve the end-to-end developer experience across Walrus's product surfaces and key workflows.

 - Lead discovery with product and engineering. Help frame problems before the team jumps to solutions, identify unanswered questions, and determine what evidence we need before committing to build.

 - Bring developers directly into the design process. Conduct lightweight developer interviews and usability tests, put prototypes in front of real users, and synthesize findings into decisions the team can act on.

 - Design complex technical workflows. Create flows, wireframes, prototypes, and production-ready designs for experiences involving dense data, system state, configuration, resource management, and high-consequence actions.

 - Influence product direction. Bring a strong point of view on what Walrus should build—not just how features should look—and constructively challenge product and engineering assumptions when needed.

 - Build Walrus's design system. Establish and maintain shared components, interaction patterns, and product principles that create consistency and allow the product surface to grow without fragmenting.

 - Benchmark the market. Regularly tear down comparable developer and infrastructure products to understand established patterns, identify opportunities, and avoid reinventing solved problems.

 - Stay close through implementation. Partner with engineering throughout development, review what ships against the intended experience, catch problems early, and incorporate requirements and feedback from partners such as Legal.

 - Raise the design bar. Establish what excellent developer-product design looks like for Walrus and help create the practices that maintain that standard as the organization grows.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 8-10 years of product design experience, with demonstrated ownership of complex technical products.

 - A portfolio demonstrating ownership of shipped developer tools, cloud/infrastructure products, consoles, dashboards, or similarly complex technical products.

 - Demonstrated ability to simplify technically sophisticated workflows without removing the control or information expert users need.

 - Strong interaction-design skills across data-heavy interfaces, tables, configuration, complex states, progressive disclosure, permissions, errors, and high-consequence actions.

 - Experience independently identifying and framing product problems rather than primarily executing against predefined requirements.

 - A track record of influencing product strategy and roadmap decisions through design.

 - Strong qualitative research instincts and experience incorporating lightweight user research and usability testing into day-to-day product work.

 - Experience creating or significantly evolving design systems and reusable interaction patterns.

 - Strong partnership with engineering and a willingness to remain involved through implementation and design QA.

 - Excellent communication skills and the confidence to disagree constructively with senior product and engineering partners.

 - Comfort operating with significant autonomy in an ambiguous, rapidly evolving technical environment.
